name: Exp_BrainTrend2_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_X2MACandle_MMRec
summary: This EA combines BrainTrend2 signal indicators with AbsolutelyNoLagLwma and X2MACandle indicators to generate trend-following trade entries. It uses a money management recovery (MMRec) system that adjusts lot sizes based on previous trade outcomes. The strategy opens positions when multiple indicators confirm the same trend direction.
summary_zh: 该EA结合BrainTrend2信号指标、AbsolutelyNoLagLwma和X2MACandle指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。它采用资金管理恢复(MMRec)系统，根据前次交易结果调整仓位大小。当多个指标确认同一趋势方向时开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个多指标确认的趋势跟踪系统，核心策略依赖三个指标的协同信号：BrainTrend2作为主趋势方向判断，AbsolutelyNoLagLwma作为零滞后均线过滤器，X2MACandle作为MACD蜡烛图形态确认。入场条件要求三个指标同时发出同向信号才开仓，例如BrainTrend2看涨、AbsolutelyNoLagLwma向上、X2MACandle为阳线时做多。出场条件通常为指标信号反转或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理采用MMRec机制，在连续亏损后尝试通过调整仓位大小来恢复资金，这是一种类似于马丁格尔的递增仓位策略。资金管理方面支持固定手数和基于账户余额的动态计算两种模式。该EA的止损和止盈参数可配置，但MMRec恢复机制在极端行情下可能带来较大风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a multi-indicator confirmation trend-following system whose core strategy relies on the synergy of three indicators: BrainTrend2 as the primary trend direction filter, AbsolutelyNoLagLwma as a zero-lag moving average filter, and X2MACandle as a MACD candlestick pattern confirmation. Entry conditions require all three indicators to emit a signal in the same direction simultaneously — for example, a long position is opened when BrainTrend2 signals bullish, AbsolutelyNoLagLwma points upward, and X2MACandle shows a bullish candle. Exit conditions are typically triggered by indicator signal reversals or reaching configured stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing employs an MMRec (Money Management Recovery) mechanism that adjusts lot sizes after consecutive losses in an attempt to recover account equity, which is akin to a martingale-style progressive position sizing approach. Money management supports both fixed lot and dynamic balance-based calculation modes. While the EA provides configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters, the MMRec recovery mechanism can introduce significant risk during extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理模式

parameters.name: MartingaleCoefficient
parameters.description: 马丁格尔系数，控制亏损后加仓倍数
parameters.description_en: Martingale coefficient for lot multiplier after loss

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points (unused; buy TP follows MA value)

pros: 三指标联合确认减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
零滞后均线过滤器降低延迟，提升信号及时性
参数化设计灵活，可针对不同品种和周期优化
支持固定手数和动态资金管理两种模式
多时间框架趋势确认逻辑较完善
pros_en: Triple indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Zero-lag moving average filter minimizes delay and enhances signal timeliness
Flexible parameterized design allows optimization for different instruments and timeframes
Supports both fixed lot and dynamic money management modes
Multi-timeframe trend confirmation logic is relatively well-designed
cons: MMRec恢复机制本质是马丁格尔变体，连续亏损时风险呈指数级增长
默认止损为0意味着不设止损，极端行情可能爆仓
多指标确认可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期阶段
缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，高成本时段交易影响收益
指标参数过多，优化空间大但容易过拟合历史数据
cons_en: The MMRec recovery mechanism is essentially a martingale variant, where risk grows exponentially during consecutive losses
Default stop-loss of 0 means no stop-loss is set, which can lead to account blowup in extreme markets
Multi-indicator confirmation may cause delayed entries, missing the early stages of trends
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, trading during high-cost periods hurts profitability
Excessive indicator parameters create large optimization space prone to overfitting historical data
improvements: 移除或限制MMRec马丁格尔机制，改用固定比例或风险平价仓位管理
添加强制止损机制和最大回撤保护，防止极端行情下账户失控
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免高成本时段交易
improvements_en: Remove or limit the MMRec martingale mechanism, replace with fixed-fractional or risk-parity position sizing
Add mandatory stop-loss mechanism and maximum drawdown protection to prevent account loss in extreme markets
Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid trading during high-cost periods

risk_points: MMRec马丁格尔恢复机制在连续亏损时递增仓位，可能导致灾难性亏损
默认止损为0，没有硬性风险底线保护
缺乏最大持仓和最大回撤限制
risk_points_en: MMRec martingale recovery mechanism increments position size after consecutive losses, potentially leading to catastrophic losses
Default stop-loss of 0 provides no hard risk floor protection
Lacks maximum position limit and maximum drawdown constraints
